item: extract_failed now says what it was handed (F11 diagnosis aid)
summary: Diagnostics finding F11: 50 consecutive linfodrome.com articles were discarded and nothing recorded why (trafilatura's own log line carries no URL). An extract_failed outcome now reads 'no article body extracted (status N, N chars, content-type X, markers ...)' with markers from a fixed list (consent, bot_check, needs_js, paywall) found in the first 200k chars, and the pass logs the final URL beside it. Numbers and fixed labels only, never page text; the outcome is unchanged. The extractor fix itself waits for saved HTML of the site.
